force_peak: per-group maximum across8 physical substeps within each policy step; group maxima may occur at different instants
body_axis: positiveX is robot forward; rearward means decreasing body-relative wheelX
length_note: root-wheel planar distance is a recorded proxy, not the exact virtual leg-length coordinate used by the reward
render: saved qpos; display actual step collision boxes; camera295degrees on approach side; visual-only display changes
